title: incident-bot: oncall runbook autodiagnostics helpers + SLO hints
author: Ava Ramirez
description: Add helper utilities and SLO hinting for incident-bot automated diagnostics and on-call runbook suggestions. Motivation: multiple on-call shifts reported missing contextual hints when the incident-bot surfaced runbook links during SLO alerts. This PR adds a set of small, composable helpers to enrich runbook suggestions with SLO context, error-sample extraction, and compact diagnostic summaries so on-call engineers can triage faster. Implementation summary: (1) new `runbook_hints` helpers that attach SLO slice, recent error-rate trend, and top 3 correlated logs to runbook suggestions; (2) `compact_diag` formatter to produce brief diagnostics used in Slack threads and pager messages; (3) integration points with existing autodiagnostics pipeline so hints are included only when SLO confidence > 0.6; (4) unit and integration tests plus end-to-end smoke test against a local simulator. Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-3174) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] E2E smoke - [x] Docs update (short note in incident-bot/README) - [x] Add feature flag for gradual rollout Rollout plan: feature gated under `autodiag.oncall_hints` with default off; staged rollout to 5% orgs for 48 hours, then 50%, then 100% pending telemetry. Backwards compatibility: helpers are additive, default behavior unchanged when feature flag is off. Security/PII: all log snippets are truncated and sanitized using existing sanitizer utilities. Related: ENG-3174 (design), INC-1204 (customer escalations).

review_comments: Jordan Kim (2025-11-15): Nice concise helpers. A couple of questions: (1) How do we ensure log snippets don't leak PII? (2) Could you make the SLO confidence threshold configurable per-organization?

Ava Ramirez (2025-11-15): Good points. We reuse the existing sanitizer utils to strip PII and truncate snippets at 512 chars; added explicit note in docs. The threshold is a feature-flag parameter exposed in deploy/feature_flags.yaml so ops can tune per-org rollout.
Priya Nair (2025-11-16): Tests look thorough. Please add a small test for the sanitizer path when snippets exceed length and one for when SLO confidence is exactly at the threshold.
Ava Ramirez (2025-11-16): Added tests for both cases (see test_compact_diag_integration.py).
Samir Gupta (2025-11-18): Approving after small nits fixed (doc wording and a stray TODO).
release_notes: Add on-call runbook autodiagnostics helpers: SLO hint enrichment and compact diagnostics formatter. Feature gated and rolled out gradually. Improves on-call triage time by surfacing correlated logs and SLO slices alongside runbook links.
testing_notes: Unit + integration + e2e smoke run locally and in CI. Added synthetic test harness to simulate SLO alerts and verify runbook enrichment behavior under feature flag on/off.
documentation_changes: Updated incident-bot/README.md with usage and rollout notes; added feature flag docs in deploy/feature_flags.yaml entry for autodiag.oncall_hints.
notes_for_oncall: When enabled, incident-bot will append a short SLO hint (slice + trend) and up to 3 correlated log snippets to runbook suggestions. If you see unexpected PII or noise, toggle autodiag.oncall_hints to false in the feature flag and file an incident referencing INC-1204.
